name: Penrose MH Master Triage (Consolidated) v11
description: v3.1 - One tree replacing 5 MH trees. One content screen captures multiple values, logic nodes route (no stacked content nodes). Scripts only stage data. Drive with ?condition=smi|depression|adult_mh|cyp|risk. Generated from Penrose exports 2026-07-13.

<style>
/* ===================================================================
   Penrose MH Master Triage — global UI skin  (Penrose / NHS blue)
   ONE source of truth for the ENTIRE tree's look & feel.
   Lives in the tree's script_code field (wrapped in <style>); a one-line
   script adds class `pz-skin` to <body> so every rule is scoped.
   Penrose is an NHS GP group ("part of the NHS family") so the palette is
   the NHS blue system. Type is fully standardised: ONE font (Arial), ONE
   body size (16px), ONE text colour (#212B32). Colour appears only in the
   severity chip on the outcome card.
   Edit here -> paste into script_code -> re-import => whole tree updates.
   =================================================================== */

:root{
  --pz-ink:#212B32; --pz-sec:#4C6272; --pz-mut:#768692;
  --pz-blue:#005EB8; --pz-blue-dk:#003087; --pz-blue-tint:#E8F0F7; --pz-blue-bd:#B3D0E8;
  --pz-surface:#FFFFFF; --pz-soft:#F0F4F5; --pz-bd:#E4E9EB; --pz-bd-strong:#D8DDE0;
  --pz-red:#D5281B; --pz-red-bg:#FDEEEC; --pz-red-bd:#F4C7C1;
  --pz-amber:#8A5A10; --pz-amber-bg:#FFF4D6; --pz-amber-bd:#F0E0B0;
  --pz-green:#007F3B; --pz-green-bg:#E7F3EC; --pz-green-bd:#BFE0CB;
  --pz-radius:12px;
  --pz-font:Arial,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,sans-serif;
}

/* ---- UNIFORM base: one font, one size, one colour ---- */
body.pz-skin{ font-family:var(--pz-font); color:var(--pz-ink); background:var(--pz-surface); line-height:1.55; }
.pz-skin, .pz-skin p, .pz-skin li, .pz-skin span, .pz-skin div, .pz-skin td, .pz-skin em, .pz-skin b, .pz-skin strong{
  font-family:var(--pz-font); color:var(--pz-ink);
}
.pz-skin p, .pz-skin li{ font-size:16px; }
.pz-skin h1,.pz-skin h2,.pz-skin h3,.pz-skin h4{ font-family:var(--pz-font)!important; color:var(--pz-ink)!important; line-height:1.3; letter-spacing:-.01em; }
.pz-skin h1{font-size:22px!important;} .pz-skin h2{font-size:20px!important;}
.pz-skin h3{font-size:18px!important;} .pz-skin h4{font-size:16px!important;}
.pz-skin hr{ border:none; border-top:1px solid var(--pz-bd); margin:18px 0; }
.pz-skin p:empty{ display:none; }

/* ---- DE-NOISE: crush ALL pasted inline styling to the uniform base ---- */
.pz-skin [style]{ font-family:var(--pz-font)!important; font-size:16px!important; color:var(--pz-ink)!important; }
.pz-skin [id="isPasted"]{ margin:0 0 .5rem; }
/* remove the stray empty green "copy" button that shipped inside pasted notes */
.pz-skin .btn-success:empty{ display:none!important; }

/* ---- "Say this" script blocks (Zingtree zt-content-block) ---- */
.pz-skin .zt-content-block{
  border:none!important; border-left:4px solid var(--pz-blue)!important;
  background:var(--pz-soft)!important; border-radius:0 var(--pz-radius) var(--pz-radius) 0;
  padding:13px 16px!important; margin:0 0 16px!important;
}
.pz-skin .zt-cb-title{ background:transparent!important; border:none!important; padding:0!important; margin:0 0 5px!important; }
.pz-skin .zt-cb-title i,.pz-skin .zt-cb-icon{ display:none!important; }
.pz-skin .zt-cb-title h3{ font-size:0!important; margin:0!important; }
.pz-skin .zt-cb-title h3::after{
  content:"SAY THIS"; font-size:11px!important; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.07em;
  color:var(--pz-blue)!important; font-family:var(--pz-font);
}
.pz-skin .zt-cb-body{ padding:0!important; background:transparent!important; }
.pz-skin .zt-cb-body p{ font-style:italic; margin:0 0 6px; } .pz-skin .zt-cb-body p:last-child{ margin-bottom:0; }

/* ---- callouts (add class in node content) ---- */
.pz-skin .pz-tip,.pz-skin .pz-task,.pz-skin .pz-crisis{ border-radius:var(--pz-radius); padding:12px 15px; margin:0 0 16px; }
.pz-skin .pz-tip{ background:var(--pz-blue-tint); border:1px solid var(--pz-blue-bd); }
.pz-skin .pz-task{ background:var(--pz-green-bg); border:1px solid var(--pz-green-bd); }
.pz-skin .pz-crisis{ background:var(--pz-red-bg); border:1px solid var(--pz-red-bd); }
.pz-skin .pz-callout-title{ font-size:13px!important; font-weight:700; margin:0 0 8px; }
.pz-skin .pz-row{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; padding:7px 0; border-top:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.06); }
.pz-skin .pz-row:first-of-type{ border-top:none; }
.pz-skin .pz-row b{ white-space:nowrap; }

/* ---- native form fields (clean; no appearance override so the
        filterable/native dropdown renders correctly) ---- */
.pz-skin label,.pz-skin .zt-form-label,.pz-skin .form-label{
  display:block; font-size:14.5px!important; font-weight:700; color:var(--pz-ink)!important; margin:0 0 7px;
}
.pz-skin select,.pz-skin input[type="text"],.pz-skin input[type="number"],
.pz-skin input[type="email"],.pz-skin input[type="date"],.pz-skin textarea,.pz-skin .form-control{
  width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; font-family:var(--pz-font); font-size:16px; color:var(--pz-ink);
  background:var(--pz-surface); border:1px solid var(--pz-bd-strong); border-radius:8px;
  padding:10px 12px; margin:0 0 16px; transition:border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s;
}
.pz-skin select:focus,.pz-skin input:focus,.pz-skin textarea:focus{
  outline:none; border-color:var(--pz-blue); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,94,184,.15);
}

/* ---- nav / answer buttons (base template primary colour is also blue via
        css_include; these keep it consistent if class names match) ---- */
.pz-skin .zt-button,.pz-skin .zt-btn,.pz-skin .zingtree-button,.pz-skin .answer-button,.pz-skin .btn.zt-nav{
  font-family:var(--pz-font)!important; font-weight:700!important; font-size:15px!important;
  background:var(--pz-blue)!important; border:1px solid var(--pz-blue)!important; color:#fff!important;
  border-radius:8px!important; padding:11px 18px!important; box-shadow:none!important;
}
.pz-skin .zt-button:hover,.pz-skin .zt-btn:hover,.pz-skin .zingtree-button:hover,
.pz-skin .answer-button:hover,.pz-skin .btn.zt-nav:hover{ background:var(--pz-blue-dk)!important; border-color:var(--pz-blue-dk)!important; }

/* ===================================================================
   OUTCOME CARD  (node 90). Tone is baked into chip_html by the catalog,
   so NO merge field is ever placed inside an HTML attribute.
   =================================================================== */
.pz-skin .pz-card{ border:1px solid var(--pz-bd); border-radius:13px; overflow:hidden; background:var(--pz-surface); box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.05); margin:4px 0 20px; }
.pz-skin .pz-card-head{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:15px 18px; background:var(--pz-soft); border-bottom:1px solid var(--pz-bd); }
.pz-skin .pz-card-title{ font-size:19px!important; font-weight:700; }
.pz-skin .pz-chip{ margin-left:auto; font-size:11.5px!important; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.02em; padding:4px 12px; border-radius:999px; white-space:nowrap; }
.pz-skin .pz-chip-routine{ background:var(--pz-green-bg); color:var(--pz-green)!important; }
.pz-skin .pz-chip-escalate,.pz-skin .pz-chip-urgent{ background:var(--pz-amber-bg); color:var(--pz-amber)!important; }
.pz-skin .pz-chip-emergency{ background:var(--pz-red-bg); color:var(--pz-red)!important; }
.pz-skin .pz-card-body{ padding:16px 18px; }
.pz-skin .pz-mini{ font-size:10.5px!important; letter-spacing:.07em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--pz-mut)!important; font-weight:700; margin:0 0 8px; }
.pz-skin .pz-suggested{ white-space:pre-line; font-size:16px!important; line-height:1.55; margin:0; }
.pz-skin .pz-copy{ display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; margin-top:14px; font-size:13px!important; font-weight:700; color:var(--pz-blue-dk)!important; background:var(--pz-surface); border:1px solid var(--pz-blue-bd); border-radius:8px; padding:8px 14px; cursor:pointer; text-decoration:none; transition:background .15s,border-color .15s; }
.pz-skin .pz-copy:hover{ background:var(--pz-blue-tint); border-color:var(--pz-blue); }
.pz-skin .pz-notes{ margin-top:18px; padding-top:16px; border-top:1px dashed var(--pz-bd); }
.pz-skin .pz-notes p,.pz-skin .pz-notes li{ font-size:16px!important; }
.pz-skin .pz-notes ul,.pz-skin .pz-notes ol{ padding-left:20px; }

/* legacy copy button that carries text (keep it, in blue) */
.pz-skin .btn-success:not(:empty){ background:var(--pz-blue)!important; border-color:var(--pz-blue)!important; color:#fff!important; border-radius:8px!important; font-weight:700!important; box-shadow:none!important; }
.pz-skin .btn-success:not(:empty):hover{ background:var(--pz-blue-dk)!important; }

</style>
<script>(function(){try{document.body.classList.add('pz-skin');}catch(e){}})();</script>

Script

"What can I help you with today?"

The aim is to ask an open-ended question and then click the options listed. (i.e., do not read the red buttons out as a list).


If the patient is not specifically calling about:

  • addiction assistance, 
  • ADHD/autism, 
  • panic attacks, 
  • medication review, or 
  • review appointment, 

AND 

😶 they are reluctant to discuss the reason for calling ➡ select Speak to a clinician about their mental health button below.

42.node_name: CYP - crisis lines + risk assessment intro
42.content:
Inform patient that you will send them these crisis line numbers before continuing to triage their symptoms. Confirm that they are happy to receive a text on their mobile number. The mobile number on EMIS may belong to a parent / guardian.


❇️ Crisis line contact information

SLaM Crisis number now NHS 111

On 1 April 2026, SLaM current 24/7 crisis line number for mental health crisis support (0800 731 2864) is transitioning to NHS 111. You’ll still reach the same local crisis teams - this change of numbers just makes it easier and quicker to access help through NHS 111. Anyone, of any age, experiencing a mental health crisis, or worried about a friend or family member, should call NHS 111 and select the mental health option after that time.


Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services (CAMHS) - 020 3228 5980


PRESS CONTINUE BELOW

✴️ Inform the patient that you will now complete a risk assessment with them. This is an important part of getting them the right care.

The questions may be repetitive but we are trying to gather as much information as possible.

200.content:
# claude.md - Penrose MH Master Triage (Consolidated) v11 ## Purpose Single decision-support tree for Penrose Health call handlers triaging mental-health calls. Consolidates five source trees so Penrose edits in ONE place: Severe Mental Illness Review (119519550), Adult Mental Health (301156332), Depression Review (425412984), Children & Young People MH & LD (685738840), MH Risk Assessment (781007709 - shared, reused by SMI/Adult/CYP). ## THE HOUSE ROUTING PATTERN (script-before-router) Every routing decision is: EVAL SCRIPT -> ROUTER (logic node). The script does ALL evaluation (reads native form-field values with ZT.getVariableValue, normalizes, applies business logic) and SAVES a boolean flag (e.g. smi_is_risk, adult_is_risk, dep_go_postcard, cyp_go_school, cyp_sym_continue, risk_is_moderate, outcome_is_other). The router (advanced_logic_node="1") does NOTHING but route on that flag: `flag == true` -> node, empty default button -> fallback. Routers NEVER contain evaluation (no raw form-field comparisons, no checkbox math, no multi-condition chains, no op-based score calc). No snaky chains (a logic node falling into another logic node) and no scripts hanging off each branch of a router. ## Native inputs (rule) Capture data with NATIVE form fields on a content node, never dynamic HTML unless the value is a complex type (multi-select, arrays, per-item rendered datasets). Native palette (all editor-native, script-readable): select (incl. filterable and dynamic-from-transforms-array via config), radio, checkbox, text, multiline, number, date, email, and conditional fields (config.conditional). Yes/No questions are `select` with options "Yes\nNo". Checkboxes were replaced by Yes/No selects here because unticked checkboxes are NOT reliably readable in a script; selects always return a value, which is what lets the eval script do the evaluation. ## Entry model Launch with ?condition=smi|adult_mh|depression|cyp|risk OR pick on node 3. Node 1 (Init script) maps the value and sets flags (needs_picker, cond_*). Node 2 (single router) routes: needs_picker->3, cond_smi->10, cond_adult_mh->20, cond_depression->30, cond_cyp->40, cond_risk->60, default->3. (The old two-node picker chain 2->4 was merged into node 2.) ## Per-condition flow (all script-before-router) - SMI: 10 entry -> 11 (3 Yes/No selects: feelsUnsafe/suicidal/harm) -> 210 eval (smi_is_risk; sets outcome_key smi:mhn if not risk) -> 13 router (risk->61, else->88). - Adult MH: 20 -> 21 self/child/crisis (action buttons: crisis->61, child->40, else->22 Choices). 22 Choices / 23 ADHD / 24 Med-review use ACTION BUTTONS (genuine branches) into thin outcome setters or sub-trees. 25 (seen_before + safety_feeling selects) -> 27 eval (sets outcome_key any_seen/mhn_safe or adult_is_risk) -> 26 router (risk->61, else->88). - Depression: 30 -> 31 (new_symptoms + about_medication selects) -> 34 eval (dep_go_postcard; sets outcome_key pharmacist/mhn) -> 33 router (postcard->32 nav, else->88). - CYP: 40 -> 41 emergency (buttons: Yes->42 crisis-lines->62 risk questions; No->44 willing). 44 (buttons: No->125 decline outcome; Yes->45). 45 (non_verbal select + 5 symptom Yes/No selects) -> 211 eval (sets outcome_key emergency_out/paramedic or cyp_sym_continue) -> 212 router (continue->48, else->88). 48 (undiagnosed + worsening selects) -> 55 eval (cyp_go_school) -> 49 router (school->52->cyp:gp setter, else->50). 50 (start_medications + urgent_script selects) -> 56 eval (sets outcome_key gp/urgent_pharm/gp_accurx) -> 88 (no router; all three terminal). - MH Risk Assessment (shared): 60 entry OR arrive at 61 consent (agree->62, decline->131 oversight). 62 = ONE screen: 6 Yes/No risk selects (suicide 1/2, self-harm 1/2, harm 1/2) + 3 social/family selects. 70 eval computes risk_score (gated, source values: suicide any=7; self-harm1=1 +7 if self-harm2; harm1=1 +1 if harm2) and sets outcome_key risk:emergency (>=7) / risk:mhn_routine (=0) or risk_is_moderate. 72 Task -> 73 router (moderate->74, else->88). 74 (appt available? buttons) -> 134 risk:mhn_appt / 135 risk:mhn_oversight.
